components.title: Accordion
components.description: Reveals related sections without leaving the current context.
components.usage: Use for optional supporting content when several sections share the same hierarchy.

components.title: Alert
components.description: Places persistent contextual information beside the work it affects.
components.usage: Use for information, warnings, success, or errors that must remain visible in context.
accessibility: Urgent alerts use the correct live-region role

components.title: Alert Dialog
components.description: Interrupts the flow for a decision with significant consequences.
components.usage: Use only when the person must explicitly confirm or cancel a consequential action.

components.title: Aspect Ratio
components.description: Keeps media and visual previews within a predictable proportion.
components.usage: Use when layout stability depends on media dimensions before the asset loads.
accessibility: The ratio does not crop essential content

components.title: Attachment
components.description: Shows a file or image with metadata, transfer state, and actions.
components.usage: Use in upload and conversation flows where file identity and progress must stay clear.

components.title: Avatar
components.description: Represents a person or entity with an image and resilient fallback.
components.usage: Use when identity supports scanning, responsibility, or conversation context.

components.title: Badge
components.description: Adds concise classification or status metadata to nearby content.
components.usage: Use for short labels that supplement a primary title rather than replacing it.
accessibility: Interactive badges use button or link semantics

components.title: Breadcrumb
components.description: Explains a resource's location through a hierarchy of destinations.
components.usage: Use for nested information architecture when returning to parent levels is useful.

components.title: Bubble
components.description: Frames conversational content with alignment, grouping, and reactions.
components.usage: Use when message direction or grouping helps distinguish turns in a conversation.
accessibility: Alignment is not the only speaker cue

components.title: Button
components.description: Initiates an immediate action with clear hierarchy and feedback.
components.usage: Use for operations that change state, submit data, or open an interaction layer.
accessibility: Disabled state is not an explanation

components.title: Button Group
components.description: Aligns closely related actions within one shared silhouette.
components.usage: Use when actions operate on the same object and benefit from compact adjacency.
accessibility: Visual joining does not merge semantics

components.title: Calendar
components.description: Supports date and range selection in a navigable calendar grid.
components.usage: Use when seeing weekday and month context improves date selection accuracy.
accessibility: Arrow keys move within the grid
Selected and today states are announced

components.title: Card
components.description: Groups related content and actions into one bounded surface.
components.usage: Use when independent grouping clarifies a subject or task; prefer spacing when a boundary adds no meaning.
accessibility: Clickable cards expose one primary target

components.title: Carousel
components.description: Moves through a bounded sequence with swipe and explicit controls.
components.usage: Use for a small ordered set when showing every item at once would weaken focus.
accessibility: Keyboard controls do not trap focus

components.title: Chart
components.description: Visualizes quantitative relationships with token-aware series and labels.
components.usage: Use when shape and trend communicate a relationship faster than a table alone.
accessibility: A text or table summary is available

components.title: Checkbox
components.description: Selects one or more independent options.
components.usage: Use when each option can be chosen separately and an indeterminate group state may apply.
accessibility: Errors are associated with the group

components.title: Collapsible
components.description: Expands or collapses one supporting panel from a single trigger.
components.usage: Use for progressive disclosure when only one independent region needs control.
accessibility: Content remains after the trigger in reading order

components.title: Combobox
components.description: Combines text input with a searchable suggestion list.
components.usage: Use when the option set is too large for a select and typed filtering helps.
accessibility: No-result state has a recovery path

components.title: Command
components.description: Searches and invokes a compact set of destinations and actions.
components.usage: Use for expert navigation or action discovery when labels and shortcuts are known.

components.title: Context Menu
components.description: Shows actions related to a target through a secondary pointer gesture.
components.usage: Use only as an acceleration path; essential actions remain available elsewhere.
accessibility: Keyboard users have an equivalent path

components.title: Data Table
components.description: Adds sorting, filtering, selection, and pagination to structured rows.
components.usage: Use for task-oriented datasets whose controls need to remain tied to tabular semantics.
accessibility: Overflow lives in a named region

components.title: Date Picker
components.description: Combines a formatted date field with calendar selection and presets.
components.usage: Use when a compact form needs both typed clarity and visual date context.
accessibility: The selected date is readable as text
Locale formats do not alter stored meaning

components.title: Dialog
components.description: Focuses attention on a contained decision or short task.
components.usage: Use when work must resolve or dismiss before returning to the underlying context.
accessibility: Title and description label the dialog

components.title: Direction
components.description: Provides left-to-right or right-to-left reading direction to descendants.
components.usage: Use at a locale or content boundary when direction differs from the surrounding page.
accessibility: The HTML direction matches reading order

components.title: Drawer
components.description: Presents a task surface that enters from a viewport edge with drag behavior.
components.usage: Use for compact or mobile workflows that benefit from a spatially connected sheet.

components.title: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Opens a compact list of actions or choices from a trigger.
components.usage: Use for secondary actions that share context and do not need persistent visibility.

components.title: Empty
components.description: Explains why a collection has no content and what to do next.
components.usage: Use for initial, filtered, or permission-based absence with a specific recovery path.
accessibility: The next action is keyboard reachable

components.title: Field
components.description: Composes a persistent label, control, help text, and validation message.
components.usage: Use as the standard boundary for collecting one value or a related control group.

components.title: Hover Card
components.description: Previews supporting content behind a link without changing destination.
components.usage: Use when a short preview helps decide whether to follow a link.
accessibility: The link works without the preview

components.title: Input
components.description: Collects a short text value with persistent labelling and validation.
components.usage: Use for a single line of text, number, date string, or other concise value.
accessibility: Autocomplete and input mode are intentional

components.title: Input Group
components.description: Combines an input with closely related prefixes, suffixes, or actions.
components.usage: Use when an addon clarifies units, scope, or an action intrinsic to the entered value.
accessibility: Focus remains visually clear across the group

components.title: Input OTP
components.description: Collects a fixed-length verification code with paste support.
components.usage: Use for short one-time codes while preserving ordinary keyboard and clipboard behavior.
accessibility: The code is one labelled input
Errors do not clear the value

components.title: Item
components.description: Aligns media, primary content, metadata, and actions in a reusable row.
components.usage: Use for list content whose internal alignment repeats across several records.

components.title: Kbd
components.description: Displays a keyboard key or shortcut as supplemental input guidance.
components.usage: Use beside an available action; never make the shortcut the only discoverable label.

components.title: Label
components.description: Names a form control with a persistent, clickable association.
components.usage: Use for every form control unless the native element already supplies a visible name.
accessibility: The for and id association is valid
Required meaning is not visual only

components.title: Marker
components.description: Marks an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labelled separator.
components.usage: Use to distinguish system context inside a conversation without resembling a person message.
accessibility: System authorship is stated in text
Status does not rely on color

components.title: Menubar
components.description: Provides persistent access to a stable set of application commands.
components.usage: Use in desktop-like workspaces where command groups stay consistent across tasks.

components.title: Message
components.description: Composes a conversational turn with identity, content, metadata, and actions.
components.usage: Use for one authored turn while keeping chronological order independent of visual alignment.

components.title: Message Scroller
components.description: Anchors conversation turns, preserves history position, and jumps to any message.
components.usage: Use for long or streamed conversations where reading position must survive updates.
accessibility: The transcript is a named region

components.title: Native Select
components.description: Uses the platform select control with Comfort styling and semantics.
components.usage: Use for a short option list when native mobile and keyboard behavior is preferable.
accessibility: The native element keeps its label

components.title: Navigation Menu
components.description: Organizes primary destinations and optional grouped previews.
components.usage: Use for site-level navigation whose groups need more context than a single link row.

components.title: Pagination
components.description: Moves between stable pages of a larger result set.
components.usage: Use when page boundaries are meaningful and shareable navigation matters.
accessibility: Unavailable directions are disabled or absent

components.title: Popover
components.description: Displays focused rich content next to a trigger without blocking the page.
components.usage: Use for compact controls or information that belongs spatially to its trigger.
accessibility: Outside dismissal does not lose work

components.title: Progress
components.description: Communicates known completion for a bounded task.
components.usage: Use when a meaningful minimum and maximum let the person understand remaining work.
accessibility: Value, minimum, and maximum are programmatic
A text label names the task
Indeterminate work uses a different pattern

components.title: Radio Group
components.description: Selects exactly one option from a visible set.
components.usage: Use when all choices should remain visible for comparison and one is required at most.
accessibility: Arrow keys move within the group

components.title: Resizable
components.description: Lets people adjust adjacent panel proportions with pointer or keyboard.
components.usage: Use in workspaces where panel size changes the usefulness of simultaneous content.

components.title: Scroll Area
components.description: Adds consistent scroll affordances to a bounded overflow region.
components.usage: Use only where regional overflow is necessary and the boundary remains visible.
accessibility: The region is named when meaningful

components.title: Select
components.description: Chooses one option from a compact custom menu.
components.usage: Use when a custom option surface is needed and the choices remain concise.
accessibility: The trigger keeps a visible label

components.title: Separator
components.description: Creates a quiet visual or semantic boundary between related groups.
components.usage: Use sparingly when spacing alone cannot explain the grouping transition.

components.title: Sheet
components.description: Extends a dialog from an edge for complementary work or navigation.
components.usage: Use when preserving the relationship to the underlying page matters more than a centered modal.

components.title: Sidebar
components.description: Provides persistent or collapsible secondary navigation for a workspace.
components.usage: Use when destinations or tools remain stable across several related screens.

components.title: Skeleton
components.description: Reserves the final content geometry while predictable data loads.
components.usage: Use only when the result shape is known and no usable previous content exists.
accessibility: Placeholders are hidden from reading order

components.title: Slider
components.description: Selects a value or range from a bounded numeric scale.
components.usage: Use when relative adjustment is more important than entering an exact number.
accessibility: Minimum, maximum, and value are named
Exact entry is offered when precision matters

components.title: Spinner
components.description: Indicates short indeterminate work inside a compact action or region.
components.usage: Use when progress cannot be measured and the expected wait is brief.
accessibility: A text status names the work
Reduced motion uses a static indicator

components.title: Switch
components.description: Changes a setting that takes effect immediately.
components.usage: Use for a reversible on or off setting whose result applies without a separate submit.

components.title: Table
components.description: Compares structured information across rows and columns.
components.usage: Use when values need consistent alignment and cross-row comparison.
accessibility: Overflow is a named focusable region only when needed

components.title: Tabs
components.description: Switches between peer views without changing the surrounding context.
components.usage: Use when a small set of related panels share one level of hierarchy.
accessibility: Panels preserve a logical reading order

components.title: Textarea
components.description: Collects longer free-form text while preserving labels and validation.
components.usage: Use when the expected answer needs multiple lines or benefits from visible editing space.
accessibility: Character limits are announced before blocking

components.title: Toast
components.description: Confirms a short result whose source may be outside the visible area.
components.usage: Use for brief nonblocking outcomes; keep persistent errors and required actions inline.
accessibility: Errors include an inline recovery path

components.title: Toggle
components.description: Switches one contextual command between pressed and unpressed states.
components.usage: Use for a reversible mode or formatting choice inside a toolbar.
accessibility: The mode remains visible without color

components.title: Toggle Group
components.description: Groups related pressed controls for single or multiple selection.
components.usage: Use for a compact set of peer modes that benefit from visible comparison.
accessibility: Arrow behavior matches the group pattern
Each item has a clear name

components.title: Tooltip
components.description: Provides a short supplemental label or explanation for a focused control.
components.usage: Use for concise clarification; essential instructions remain visible in the interface.
accessibility: The trigger works without the tooltip

components.title: Typography
components.description: Applies readable semantic styles to headings, prose, lists, and code.
components.usage: Use semantic elements first, then apply the Comfort type scale without changing document structure.

foundations.title: Design Token
foundations.description: A semantic vocabulary that keeps decisions portable across themes and products.
foundations.intent: Describe purpose before appearance so components can adapt without changing meaning.
rules: Keep light and dark roles parallel
accessibility: Status roles are not color only

foundations.title: Color
foundations.description: Cool neutrals create quiet structure while one blue signals interaction.
foundations.intent: Clarify hierarchy, action, and state without turning color into decoration.

foundations.title: Typography
foundations.description: A compact Geist scale for product content, supporting text, and code.
foundations.intent: Carry hierarchy through size, weight, measure, and spacing before adding surfaces.

foundations.title: Iconography
foundations.description: Consistent geometric icons support scanning without replacing labels.
foundations.intent: Use one visual grammar and let text carry meaning when an icon is unfamiliar.

foundations.title: Elevation
foundations.description: Surface contrast and restrained shadow explain real stacking relationships.
foundations.intent: Show containment and layering without making every region float.
accessibility: Selection does not rely on elevation

foundations.title: Gradient
foundations.description: Controlled ramps serve data, masks, and the established hero text treatment.
foundations.intent: Use continuous color only when continuity itself communicates information.

foundations.title: Inclusive Design
foundations.description: Semantics, contrast, focus, and forgiving interaction shape every component.
foundations.intent: Make the primary task operable across perception, input, zoom, and motion preferences.
accessibility: Assistive technology follows the same task order

foundations.title: International Design
foundations.description: Layouts and content survive translation, direction, and locale-specific formats.
foundations.intent: Treat language expansion and direction as normal product states rather than exceptions.
rules: Format dates and numbers by locale
accessibility: Language and direction attributes are correct

foundations.title: Layout
foundations.description: Responsive containers and durable reading order preserve task priority.
foundations.intent: Scale density and columns without changing meaning or moving essential actions unpredictably.
accessibility: No page overflow at 320 CSS pixels

foundations.title: Motion
foundations.description: Cause, direction, and continuity make state changes easier to understand.
foundations.intent: Explain what changed without delaying input or adding decorative travel.

foundations.title: Radius
foundations.description: A restrained shape scale keeps containers soft but precise.
foundations.intent: Express containment and nesting without turning every control into a pill.
rules: Use smaller radii inside larger surfaces
accessibility: Shape is not the only state cue
Focus rings follow the visible contour

foundations.title: Spacing
foundations.description: A four-pixel scale separates decisions and groups related content.
foundations.intent: Build hierarchy through rhythm before adding borders, cards, or decorative fill.
rules: Prefer gap over margins between siblings
accessibility: Text expansion does not collapse gaps

foundations.title: State
foundations.description: A shared lifecycle distinguishes pending, usable, empty, and recoverable outcomes.
foundations.intent: Show what is happening, what remains safe, and what action can recover the task.
rules: Use skeletons only for known geometry
accessibility: Focus does not jump without intent

foundations.title: Voice and Tone
foundations.description: Direct, calm language changes emphasis according to risk and context.
foundations.intent: Help people decide and recover without vague enthusiasm or blame.
accessibility: Urgent copy remains understandable without punctuation tricks

foundations.title: Writing
foundations.description: Specific interface copy names actions, outcomes, states, and recovery paths.
foundations.intent: Reduce interpretation by writing the next decision in plain, active language.
rules: Label actions with verb and result
accessibility: Labels make sense out of visual context
